Title: Zip Guns and Al's Army Questions

Messages.Author: n...@ix.netcom.com
Messages.Body:
Two questions for you all..

1) Are you allowed to use cards such as Al's Army, and
Fragment of Nod at anytime (i.e. in the middle of an action)?

2) Is a Zip Gun considered a gun and a combat card? Can
Thoughts Betrayed prevent you from playing a Zip Gun? Can you use
Al's Army or Vast Wealth to go and get Zip Guns from your library?

Thanks.

Greg

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <32bba7ea...@nntp.ix.netcom.com>,

n...@ix.netcom.com wrote:
> 1) Are you allowed to use cards such as Al's Army, and
> Fragment of Nod at anytime (i.e. in the middle of an action)?

Yes.

> 2) Is a Zip Gun considered a gun and a combat card? Can
> Thoughts Betrayed prevent you from playing a Zip Gun? Can you use
> Al's Army or Vast Wealth to go and get Zip Guns from your library?

It is a combat card until it enters play. Then it is a Equip:Weapon:Gun

TB (superior) will prevent you from playing the card, yes.

Since zip guns are not weapons until they are in play, no, Al's and Vast
Wealth won't retrieve them.
